g.text: Qwen3.5 P0: boundary-factor replay and historical training repeatability
Selected original evidence • GPU original-default / NPU native-level1 backward • historical TRL policies remain separate
Scope: original interval8..15 incoming cotangents and lower-graph replay; original upper gradients stay unchanged. This is not a full-model counterfactual.
Nativelevel1 repeatability at these retained arrays does not establish cross-peer repair, policy equivalence or general determinism. GPU is a reference configuration, not an oracle.

No numerical acceptance threshold, unique operator cause or selected repair. TRL scores lack independent raw full-vocabulary replay; policy guards are source-bound, not saved per-phase transition flags.
